messages:
samir: FYI customer ACME-Corp hitting 413 on /v1/rerank. They say payload "too large" but no guidance in the response. Request ID: rq_8f3c2a. Can someone triage?

support-bot: Case created: #CS-12345 — assigning to support.

oliver: Can you paste a repro (redact PII)? especially the error body and the longest doc.

samir: Truncated payload + error:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"query":"(long user query ~18k chars)","docs":[{"id":"d1","text":"(long doc1...)"}, {"id":"d2","text":"..."}, /* ~120 docs */]}'

HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{"error":"rerank_input_too_large","detail":"tokens=33500, limit=32768"}
```

alice: Looks like they counted characters not tokens — tokenization will increase counts. Quick token-counter to share:```
# python (uses tiktoken)
from tiktoken import encoding_for_model
enc = encoding_for_model("redwood-rerank-1")

def count_tokens(s):
    return len(enc.encode(s))

# use count_tokens(query) + sum(count_tokens(d["text"]) for d in docs)
```

maya: Suggest we give the customer a short triage checklist: 1) send the single longest doc text (redacted) 2) run token count on query + that doc and share numbers 3) indicate which field they put large text in (text vs. metadata) 4) confirm they aren't double-encoding (base64/html).

jack: Eng-ML note: rerank enforces a combined token ceiling (query + all docs). Current limit is 32768 tokens. Error right now returns total tokens and limit (good) but not the doc index that caused overflow. I'll open a follow-up to add doc_index and token_breakdown to the error payload — escalated to infra for UX.

samir: In the short term I gave the customer two pragmatic workarounds:
- Trim docs to a snippet field (e.g., first N chars) and send passages instead of full documents.
- Chunk docs into groups (<= ~2000 tokens per chunk) and rerank in batches, then merge ranks client-side.

Example chunking curl (pseudo):```
# chunk locally into batches then call per-batch
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"query":"...","docs":[...batch docs...]}'
```

oliver: Also remind them that failed 413 should not be billed; confirm with billing if needed but default behavior is no charge for client-side input errors.

maya: Customer asked if there is a quick snippet to auto-trim long docs. I posted a tiny Python helper that trims by token budget and keeps doc ids — shared in the thread.

samir: Customer agreed to try chunking and will send a trimmed repro tomorrow morning. Marking CS-12345 pending customer.

support-bot: Case #CS-12345 updated: awaiting customer repro.
